common_migration.canonicalStateSource: Base44 platform metadata and the authorized migration runner, never a public client payload.
common_migration.legacyFallback: Absence means the record is local to its current app or predates migration metadata.
common_migration.migrationBehavior: Set by idempotent full, incremental, late-write reconciliation, or reverse migration; never copied from staging into green production.
common_migration.adminProjectionBehavior: Included only in an allowlisted migration or administrative projection.
common_migration.retentionBehavior: Retained through the complete forward/reverse migration, reconciliation, rollback, and audit window.
common_migration.testRequirement: Validate optionality, type consistency across all four entities, admin-only FLS, composite migration identity, staging exclusion, and idempotent reruns.

canonical_state.canonicalStateSource: Strictly normalized canonical draft-state contract version 4.
canonical_state.legacyFallback: Reconstruct from existing compatibility JSON fields without discarding the source record when reconstruction warns or fails.
canonical_state.migrationBehavior: Migrate the validated canonical representation and retain existing compatibility fields during rollout.
canonical_state.adminProjectionBehavior: Return only through a scoped backend/admin projection; never through unrestricted entity access.
canonical_state.retentionBehavior: Retain with the draft lifecycle and any active support, incident, legal, or migration hold.
canonical_state.testRequirement: Round-trip canonical state, reject secrets, preserve legacy compatibility fields, and prove hash/contract-version consistency.

revision_hash.canonicalStateSource: Accepted canonical mutation and server-assigned revision metadata.
revision_hash.legacyFallback: Use revision zero and no authoritative server save time; never infer authority from client timestamps.
revision_hash.migrationBehavior: Preserve revisions and hashes; migration bookkeeping must not independently advance them.
revision_hash.adminProjectionBehavior: Expose only safe revision/conflict metadata through scoped backend responses.
revision_hash.retentionBehavior: Retain with canonical state for conflict, submission, migration, and audit integrity.
revision_hash.testRequirement: Validate monotonic revisions, idempotent same-revision/same-hash behavior, stale rejection, and stable hash parity.

identity_association.canonicalStateSource: Validated draft identity and recovery-email normalization contracts.
identity_association.legacyFallback: Map legacy user_email only through an explicit migration decision; otherwise leave the new association fields absent.
identity_association.migrationBehavior: Preserve source and verification state without upgrading unverified legacy data.
identity_association.adminProjectionBehavior: Raw/display/normalized email is allowlisted only where operationally required; hashes and normalized values remain internal.
identity_association.retentionBehavior: Retain with the draft subject to privacy, support-hold, and lifecycle retention policy.
identity_association.testRequirement: Validate normalization, provenance, explicit verification, changed-email behavior, PII-safe diagnostics, and FLS denial for anonymous callers.

recovery_authorization.canonicalStateSource: Backend-issued recovery-code verifier metadata; raw codes are transient and excluded.
recovery_authorization.legacyFallback: Legacy records remain readable but require an explicit backend migration/issuance path before code recovery is available.
recovery_authorization.migrationBehavior: Copy only versioned verifier metadata and approved hint; never copy raw or normalized code input.
recovery_authorization.adminProjectionBehavior: Verifier fields are never projected; an approved hint may appear only in an explicitly scoped support projection.
recovery_authorization.retentionBehavior: Retain with the draft until rotation, deletion eligibility, or a verified migration supersedes the verifier.
recovery_authorization.testRequirement: Reject raw code fields, enforce hash/version types and FLS, and prove ordinary reads never return verifier material.

supersession.canonicalStateSource: Server-coordinated Clear All or Start New transaction.
supersession.legacyFallback: Absence means no recorded supersession relationship; existing draft IDs remain valid.
supersession.migrationBehavior: Remap draft relationships through the durable source/destination ID map in both directions.
supersession.adminProjectionBehavior: Expose only safe scoped relationship/status fields; never expose a replacement recovery credential.
supersession.retentionBehavior: Retain the full chain for at least the draft retention and rollback evidence window.
supersession.testRequirement: Validate one replacement, bidirectional links, idempotency, terminal guards, relationship remapping, and late-write rejection.

submission_lock.canonicalStateSource: Immutable force-saved submit-attempt and PDF source snapshot.
submission_lock.legacyFallback: Use existing final submission linkage and compatibility payloads without inventing a snapshot hash.
submission_lock.migrationBehavior: Preserve immutable snapshot/hash/linkage and never regenerate from a newer blank draft.
submission_lock.adminProjectionBehavior: Snapshot content is scoped and sensitive; hashes remain backend/admin-only.
submission_lock.retentionBehavior: Retain according to completed-submission policy and the one-year submitted-response guarantee.
submission_lock.testRequirement: Prove terminal immutability, retry idempotency, snapshot/PDF hash binding, and submitted read-only recovery.

recovery_email_delivery.canonicalStateSource: Backend SES delivery coordinator using safe outcomes only.
recovery_email_delivery.legacyFallback: Absence means no durable delivery diagnostic exists.
recovery_email_delivery.migrationBehavior: Preserve safe outcome/counter/timestamps; do not copy staging recipients or test delivery identifiers into green.
recovery_email_delivery.adminProjectionBehavior: Expose safe status and error codes only; never recipient, raw code, provider credentials, or message body.
recovery_email_delivery.retentionBehavior: Retain with the draft and incident/complaint evidence window.
recovery_email_delivery.testRequirement: Exercise success/failure/retry, staging redirection, PII/secret redaction, and no rollback of a created replacement draft.

retention.canonicalStateSource: Server lifecycle timestamps, approved retention class, and authorized support-hold operations.
retention.legacyFallback: Compute eligibility from existing server/platform dates under the documented one-year policy; absence never shortens retention.
retention.migrationBehavior: Preserve holds and anchors across forward/reverse migration and exclude held records from cleanup.
retention.retentionBehavior: Dry-run first; preserve relationship, submission, audit, and rollback integrity before any deletion.
retention.testRequirement: Validate server-time eligibility, one-year boundaries, hold exemptions, dry-run evidence, and relationship-safe cleanup.

diagnostics.canonicalStateSource: Safe backend mutation, authorization, and conflict outcomes.
diagnostics.legacyFallback: Absence means no structured diagnostic was recorded.
diagnostics.migrationBehavior: Copy safe codes/IDs only and preserve source timestamps where applicable.
diagnostics.adminProjectionBehavior: Allowlisted safe codes and opaque IDs only; no values, credentials, email, code, token, or grant.
diagnostics.retentionBehavior: Retain for operational audit and incident windows without extending raw content retention.
diagnostics.testRequirement: Scan diagnostics for PII/secrets and validate bounded safe-code formats.

api_idempotency.canonicalStateSource: Accepted bootstrap, save, or event-batch requests after backend authorization and validation.
api_idempotency.legacyFallback: Absence means no authoritative API idempotency result is recorded; current legacy browser behavior remains compatible.
api_idempotency.migrationBehavior: Preserve keyed hashes and safe request IDs without copying raw client idempotency keys or secret material.
api_idempotency.adminProjectionBehavior: Omit hashes from all client and ordinary admin projections; safe request IDs are internal diagnostics only.
api_idempotency.retentionBehavior: Retain with the associated draft for retry, conflict, and audit integrity.
api_idempotency.testRequirement: Validate optionality, exact admin FLS, raw-key exclusion, retry deduplication, and projection omission.

event_contract.canonicalStateSource: Accepted draft mutation or backend lifecycle/audit operation.
event_contract.legacyFallback: Existing session-linked events remain valid without draft ID, revisions, mutation IDs, or hashes.
event_contract.migrationBehavior: Remap draft relationship, preserve event identity/order, and deduplicate by stable event_id plus composite source identity.
event_contract.adminProjectionBehavior: Admin/backend-only event metadata; existing value fields remain compatibility data pending later minimization.
event_contract.retentionBehavior: Retain at least as long as the associated draft and all active holds.
event_contract.testRequirement: Validate relationship remapping, event_id idempotency, revisions, mutation/tab linkage, value hashing/redaction, administrative actor privacy, and retention inheritance.

submission_linkage.canonicalStateSource: Finalized draft and immutable submitted-state/PDF hashes.
submission_linkage.legacyFallback: Retain existing metadata/userdata unchanged; absence of linkage fields is valid for legacy submissions.
submission_linkage.migrationBehavior: Populate only from a trustworthy source, require top-level and legacy metadata session values to agree when both exist, quarantine mismatches, and remap source draft IDs in both directions.
submission_linkage.adminProjectionBehavior: Backend/admin-only linkage and integrity hashes; metadata/userdata projections remain unchanged.
submission_linkage.retentionBehavior: Follow completed-submission retention and rollback evidence requirements.
submission_linkage.testRequirement: Prove metadata/userdata byte-shape compatibility, optional linkage, hash equality, and relationship remapping.

intake_linkage.canonicalStateSource: Fallback submission coordinator and source draft canonical hash.
intake_linkage.legacyFallback: Existing questionnaire_session_id and linked_submission_id remain authoritative compatibility links.
intake_linkage.migrationBehavior: Populate only when source mapping is trustworthy; remap source draft linkage without changing intake status/retry fields.
intake_linkage.retentionBehavior: Retain with intake retry/repair evidence and linked draft/submission integrity.
intake_linkage.testRequirement: Validate optional linkage, status-enum preservation, retry/repair compatibility, and bidirectional remapping.

external_side_effect_diagnostics.canonicalStateSource: Environment-constrained external-side-effect policy and Zapier delivery result.
external_side_effect_diagnostics.legacyFallback: Existing zapier_sent remains valid; absent diagnostics mean the historical outcome is unknown.
external_side_effect_diagnostics.migrationBehavior: Preserve safe diagnostics but exclude staging destinations, test IDs, and staging-only delivery context from green.
external_side_effect_diagnostics.adminProjectionBehavior: Safe delivery mode/status/outcome only; no destination URL, secret, response body, or payload.
external_side_effect_diagnostics.testRequirement: Validate suppressed and redirected flags independently from zapier_sent, bounded safe status text, and absence of destinations or secrets.

submission_idempotency_key_hash.migrationUse: Prevents duplicate final submission during retry and replay.

pdf_source_state_hash.migrationUse: Binds PDF regeneration to the exact submitted source state.
pdf_source_state_hash.description: Stable hash of the immutable PDF source state.

recovery_email_delivery_status.migrationUse: Preserves a safe delivery lifecycle state without recipient or code.

recovery_email_delivery_attempt_count.description: Number of backend recovery-code email delivery attempts.

recovery_email_delivery_idempotency_hash.migrationUse: Preserves a purpose-keyed delivery deduplication hash without a raw idempotency key or recovery code.
recovery_email_delivery_idempotency_hash.description: Purpose-keyed hash used to deduplicate backend recovery-email delivery.

recovery_email_delivery_purpose.migrationUse: Preserves only an allowlisted delivery purpose and never content or recipient context.

recovery_email_provider_message_id.migrationUse: Preserves a provider diagnostic identifier only under reviewed environment migration rules.

recovery_email_last_request_id.migrationUse: Preserves an opaque delivery request correlation identifier without request content.

recovery_email_last_sent_at.migrationUse: Preserves the most recent successful provider acceptance time.
recovery_email_last_sent_at.description: Server timestamp of the latest accepted recovery-code email delivery.

recovery_email_delivery_error_code.migrationUse: Preserves a bounded safe failure classification for support and retry.
recovery_email_delivery_error_code.description: Safe bounded error code for the latest recovery email delivery failure.

retention_class.migrationUse: Preserves lifecycle-specific retention policy across environments.
retention_class.description: Approved retention policy class for the record.

retention_anchor_at.migrationUse: Preserves the server-time anchor used for cleanup eligibility.
retention_anchor_at.description: Authoritative server-time anchor for retention calculation.

support_hold.migrationUse: Prevents automated cleanup while support, incident, legal, or migration work is active.
support_hold.description: Whether an authorized hold currently exempts the record from cleanup.

support_hold_reason.migrationUse: Preserves an allowlisted hold reason for operational review.
support_hold_reason.description: Controlled sensitive reason for the current support or migration hold.

support_hold_set_at.migrationUse: Preserves the server time the current hold began.

support_hold_released_at.migrationUse: Preserves the server time the hold ended.
support_hold_released_at.description: Server timestamp when the support hold was released.

cleanup_dry_run_batch_id.migrationUse: Preserves the dry-run evidence batch that evaluated cleanup eligibility.

deleted_at.migrationUse: Preserves optional soft-deletion time if a later policy authorizes that lifecycle.

last_authorization_method.migrationUse: Preserves a safe method classification for the latest authorized recovery operation.

last_authorization_outcome.migrationUse: Preserves a bounded internal outcome without exposing a public enumeration oracle.

canonical_state_hash.description: Stable hash of the associated canonical questionnaire state.

submitted_lock_version.migrationUse: Preserves the terminal submission-lock contract version.
submitted_lock_version.description: Version of the terminal submitted-state lock contract.

status_locked_at.migrationUse: Preserves authoritative terminal-lock ordering and rollback evidence.
status_locked_at.description: Server timestamp when submitted lifecycle status became terminal and immutable.

last_submission_error_code.migrationUse: Preserves only a safe bounded failure classification without exception or response content.
last_submission_error_code.description: Safe bounded code for the latest submission failure.

last_recovery_email_sent_at.migrationUse: Preserves a provider-accepted delivery timestamp while excluding staging recipient context from green.
last_recovery_email_sent_at.description: Server timestamp of the latest provider-accepted recovery-email delivery.

retention_expires_at.migrationUse: Preserves an authoritative retention boundary when present and never synthesizes one for legacy records.
retention_expires_at.description: Server-assigned retention expiration timestamp for new records.

retention_hold.migrationUse: Preserves an authorized cleanup exemption across forward and reverse migration.
retention_hold.description: Whether authorized retention cleanup must preserve this draft.

retention_hold_reason.migrationUse: Preserves the controlled sensitive reason for an active retention hold.
retention_hold_reason.description: Controlled sensitive reason for an authorized retention hold.

retention_policy_version.migrationUse: Preserves the retention-policy contract version used to assign metadata.
retention_policy_version.description: Version of the retention policy used when retention metadata was assigned.

ProFormRecoverySecurityEvent.publicProjectionRule: never expose entity rows; public functions return only allowlisted generic recovery envelopes

ProFormEmailVerificationAttempt.publicProjectionRule: never expose attempt rows; future public functions return only generic state and separately authorized recovery sessions

ProFormMigrationCheckpoint.publicProjectionRule: never expose checkpoint rows or token hashes; admin functions return only bounded safe summaries
